title: Keenly Peppery Mediterranean Cabbage Salad
description: A refreshing, crunchy salad featuring the bold flavors of the Mediterranean. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or lunch.

ingredients.name: cabbage
ingredients.notes: Any variety of cabbage works well

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a good quality extra-virgin olive oil

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: Use a microplane to finely mince

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the sliced cabbage and flaxseed.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, and red pepper flakes.
Pour the dressing over the cabbage mixture and toss to combine.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Cover the salad and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, sprinkle with black pepper and serve.
